official.deadline_note: MU runs a three-tier deadline ladder per intake rather than a single closing date. For the Fall entry of the 2027/28 academic year: Super Early Bird 15 January, Early Bird 15 March, Final Deadline 1 April 2027 for non-EU applicants who need a visa; EU/EEA citizens and residents and applicants from the listed 90-day visa-free countries have a Final Deadline of 15 August. For the Spring entry: Super Early Bird 15 June, Early Bird 15 August, Final Deadline 1 September. The named merit scholarships themselves are described as open throughout the year with limited places per intake, and the 20th Anniversary Scholarship points applicants back to these semester deadlines.
official.application_cycle: 2027/28 academic year (Fall and Spring intakes); the 20th Anniversary Scholarship is restricted to new applicants for the 2027/28 academic year
official.status_note: The official pages state that scholarship applications are accepted for the Fall and Spring semesters and are open throughout the year with limited spaces per intake; the 20th Anniversary Scholarship is assessed on a rolling basis with interviews held once per month for applicants who pass the initial document evaluation.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Both named merit scholarships state 'The scholarship award covers tuition fees only'. The tuition page separately warns: 'Attention: Tuition fees refer to cost of classroom study and MU services only, it does not include housing and other living costs.'
benefits: Undergraduate Supporting Futures Scholarship (Bachelor's): 15% of tuition at GPA above 90%, 10% at GPA above 85%, 5% at GPA above 80%; SAT composite 1300+ gives a 15% tuition reduction, 1230-1290 gives 10%, 1190-1220 gives 5%; successful applicants can receive a tuition fee reduction of up to 25%

Graduate Academic Excellence Scholarship (Master's): 15% of tuition at GPA above 90%, 10% at GPA above 85%, 5% at GPA above 80%; GMAT above 675 gives a 15% tuition reduction, 625-665 gives 10%, 535-615 gives 5%; up to 25% for the MSc programmes and up to 50% for the MBA

Modul 20th Anniversary Scholarship: a 40%, 60% or 80% scholarship award towards tuition fees for 20 new students, leaving remaining undergraduate tuition of EUR 5,400 / EUR 3,600 / EUR 1,800 and remaining Master's tuition starting from EUR 4,200 / EUR 2,800 / EUR 1,400 per semester
Early Bird Reduction: EUR 2,000 (EUR 1,000 per semester) off tuition
Siblings Reduction: 10% of the total tuition fees for following siblings

Full Tuition Fee Payment Reduction: 3% of total study programme tuition plus no tuition fee indexation; Academic Year Tuition Payment Reduction: 1.5% of academic year tuition plus no tuition fee indexation for one year
eligibility: Supporting Futures Scholarship: applicants must be applying for a Bachelor's programme at Modul University Vienna and must have a strong academic record; it is assessed on a combination of academic merit and admission interview performance and is awarded in the admission process
Graduate Academic Excellence Scholarship: applicants must have a strong academic record; the award is tied to undergraduate GPA or GMAT score

20th Anniversary Scholarship: applicants must be a new applicant to Modul University Vienna for the 2027/28 academic year, apply for an eligible degree programme (any Bachelor or MSc programme), meet the academic requirements of the chosen programme, sustain a minimum 80% GPA, demonstrate financial need, and show evidence of extracurricular, professional or community engagement

Combination rule: the Supporting Futures and Graduate Academic Excellence scholarships cannot be combined with other grants or scholarships, except for the Full Tuition Fee Payment Reduction and Academic Year Tuition Payment Reduction
Early Bird Reduction is not applicable to any Foundation Programme courses and cannot be combined with the MU Alumni Grant or the MCC Scholarship, but can be combined with other scholarships
requirements: Bachelor submission documents: curriculum vitae, letter of motivation, high school certificate, high school transcripts of records, copy of passport, passport-sized photograph, proof of English proficiency at level B2, and a recommendation letter plus certificates from extracurricular activities - all submitted in PDF format

Master submission documents: curriculum vitae, letter of motivation (1 A4 page), Bachelor's degree of a minimum of three years, Bachelor's transcripts of records, copy of passport, passport-sized photograph, two letters of recommendation from academic sources, and proof of English proficiency at level C1 - all in PDF; MBA applicants additionally need a minimum of three years of professional experience in a responsible position

20th Anniversary Scholarship extras: a 3-minute video introducing yourself to the scholarship committee and a budget showing how you plan to fund your studies and living costs in Vienna, both uploaded to the online application before submission - incomplete applications will not be considered
English test must have been taken within the last two years; the university will review an application if you can provide evidence that you have booked your English exam date
documents: Letter of motivation (Bachelor: reasons for applying to Modul University Vienna; Master: 1 A4 page)
High school certificate and high school transcripts of records (Bachelor) or Bachelor's degree of at least three years plus Bachelor's transcripts of records (Master)
Copy of passport and passport-sized photograph
Two letters of recommendation from academic sources (Master; optional teacher or counsellor reference for Undergraduate)
Proof of English proficiency (B2 for Bachelor, C1 for Master), or proof of medium of instruction where exempt
20th Anniversary Scholarship only: 3-minute video and a personal study-and-living budget, both uploaded before the application can be submitted
selection_criteria: Supporting Futures Scholarship: a combination of academic merit and admission interview performance, awarded in the admission process
Graduate Academic Excellence Scholarship: outstanding academic achievements and potential, quantified through GPA bands or GMAT score bands
20th Anniversary Scholarship: initiative and engagement outside the classroom, academic potential, financial need, and motivation and community potential - explicitly 'not based on grades alone'
Admission interview conducted on Microsoft Teams: approximately 30 minutes for undergraduate and 45 minutes for postgraduate applicants, covering motivation, background and documents
coverage: Tuition fees only - the scholarship award covers tuition fees and nothing else
Tuition fees refer only to the cost of classroom study and MU services and do not include housing or other living costs
No monthly stipend, living allowance, travel grant or installation allowance is published for any of these awards
application_method: Create an account and apply online through the MUVi application portal at apply.modul.ac.at, uploading all documents in PDF
For the 20th Anniversary Scholarship, tick that you are applying for it in the portal and upload both the 3-minute video and the budget - both are needed before the application can be submitted
The admissions team reviews the application to assure eligibility and then invites you to book an interview slot with an Admissions Coordinator; the interview is held on Microsoft Teams
The relevant Dean evaluates the application in line with the Admissions Coordinator's recommendation and the Admission committee decides; successful acceptance is either 'full' or 'conditional'
official.application_route: Apply online through the MUVi portal (apply.modul.ac.at) with your degree application; the scholarship is assessed inside the admission process, so there is no separate scholarship form for the Supporting Futures or Graduate Academic Excellence awards - for the 20th Anniversary Scholarship you tick the scholarship box and attach a 3-minute video and a budget before you can submit
official.citizenship_residency: No citizenship or residency restriction is published for the Supporting Futures Scholarship, the Graduate Academic Excellence Scholarship or the 20th Anniversary Scholarship; the university states that it offers study programmes in English to a diverse international student body. Only the US Veterans Affairs Funding route is nationality-specific (applicants from the US eligible for Post-9/11 GI Bill or Chapter 33 benefits)
official.international_eligibility: Yes - international students are eligible. All programmes are taught in English, no nationality restriction is published for these awards, and the university describes its student body as diverse and global with applicants from many countries
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Programme-specific. The Supporting Futures Scholarship supports MU's Bachelor programmes (BSc Applied Data Science, BSc International Management, BSc International Management with Professional Experience, BBA Tourism Hotel Management and Operations, BBA Tourism and Hospitality Management, BSc Human Resources Management, BA International Relations and Sustainability). The Graduate Academic Excellence Scholarship supports MSc Management, MSc International Tourism Management, MSc Sustainable Development Management and Policy, MSc Data Science for Sustainability and the MBA. The 20th Anniversary Scholarship supports any Bachelor or MSc programme; the MBA is not listed. No external agency restriction applies - all three are funded by Modul University Vienna itself
official.duration: Bachelor programmes run 6-8 semesters and Master programmes 3-4 semesters depending on the programme (for example BSc International Management 6 semesters, BSc International Management with Professional Experience 7 semesters, BBA Tourism Hotel Management and Operations 8 semesters, MSc Management 4 semesters, MBA 3 semesters, MSc International Tourism Management, MSc Sustainable Development Management and Policy and MSc Data Science for Sustainability 4 semesters each)
official.description: Modul University Vienna funds its students through tuition-fee scholarships and reductions published on its Reductions & Grants pages rather than through a central stipend scheme: an Undergraduate Supporting Futures Scholarship, a Graduate Academic Excellence Scholarship and a 20th Anniversary Scholarship that each cut tuition by a published percentage, alongside Early Bird, Siblings and advance-payment reductions. The university states that its scholarship awards 'cover tuition fees only' and that tuition 'refer[s] only to the cost of classroom study and MU services only, they do not include housing or other living costs'.
official.region: Europe (Austria - Vienna, campus at Am Kahlenberg 1)
official.program_type: Institutional tuition-fee scholarship and tuition reductions (Reductions & Grants) at a private international university
official.english_requirement: Bachelor: CEFR level B2 minimum, test taken within the last two years - TOEFL iBT 4.5 points with a minimum of 4.0 in writing, IELTS band score 6.5 with no sub-score below 6.0 and a minimum of 6.0 in writing, Cambridge First Certificate in English (FCE) grade B with a minimum of 173 points, Pearson (PTE) Academic 59 points, or Duolingo English Test 125 points with no sub-scores under 110. Master: CEFR level C1 minimum, test taken within the last two years - TOEFL 570 paper-based / 230 computer-based / 95 Internet-based, IELTS overall band score 7.0 with no sub-score below 6.5, Pearson Academic 76 points, or Cambridge Certificate BEC Higher Grade A or Cambridge Advanced Certificate of English from Grade C with a minimum of 180 points. Exceptions are considered only for native speakers or students who completed a full Bachelor's degree of at least three years taught in English and can provide proof of medium of instruction; the admissions committee may request additional evidence

not_confirmed: study_mode - the official pages list programme lengths in semesters but do not state full-time or part-time study mode
research_requirement - no research proposal or research requirement is published for these undergraduate and master's scholarships

the euro value of each percentage award - MU publishes the awards only as percentages of tuition (and, for the 20th Anniversary Scholarship, only the remaining per-semester tuition), so no single euro amount per programme was calculated

the exact Early Bird euro figure is stated inconsistently on the official site: the Reductions & Grants page gives EUR 2,000 (EUR 1,000 per semester) for the Early Bird Reduction while the admissions page lists Super Early Bird as EUR 2,000 per academic year and Early Bird as EUR 1,000 per academic year

applicant_utility.summary: Every MU award is a discount on your tuition invoice, not a cash grant - plan to fund Vienna housing and living costs entirely yourself, because MU states in writing that tuition excludes them. You do not apply for the Supporting Futures or Graduate Academic Excellence scholarship separately: it is decided inside your admission file from your GPA (or SAT/GMAT) and your Teams interview, so a weak interview can cost you the money even with a strong transcript. The one standalone call is the 20th Anniversary Scholarship, which needs a 3-minute video and a written study-and-living budget uploaded before you can even submit, and which is only open to new applicants for the 2027/28 academic year. Because MU's deadlines are a discount ladder rather than a single closing date, filing by 15 January for a Fall start is worth real money, and stacking rules matter: the merit scholarships cannot be combined with other grants except the two advance-payment reductions.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Self-funding international students with a strong transcript or standardised test score who can cover Vienna living costs themselves and who apply early for a Fall or Spring intake
application_readiness_checklist: Get your English certificate booked and sat early - the test must be under two years old, and a non-EU applicant who needs a visa cannot be issued a conditional acceptance letter without proof of English proficiency
Convert every transcript, certificate, CV and motivation letter to PDF before you open the portal; MU asks for PDF only and rejects nothing else
Work out your GPA conversion to MU's percentage bands in advance (above 80/85/90%) so you know which tuition percentage you are actually shooting for
If you are targeting the 20th Anniversary Scholarship, record and upload the 3-minute video and write the full study-and-living budget first - the portal will not let you submit without both
Line up your two academic referees early for a Master's application (or one academic plus one professional reference for the MBA) and have them sign on letter-headed paper
Budget for the timeline: interviews are about 30 minutes for undergraduate and 45 for postgraduate, and the 20th Anniversary interview includes two Scholarship Committee members
common_rejection_risks: Assuming the percentage is automatic - the bands (GPA above 80/85/90%, SAT 1190-1300+, GMAT 535-675+) only set the ceiling, and the award is confirmed in the admission decision, so a mediocre interview or thin file can land you nothing
Submitting a 20th Anniversary application without the video or the budget - MU says explicitly that incomplete applications will not be considered
Applying for the 20th Anniversary Scholarship with an MBA in mind - the call lists any Bachelor or MSc programme and omits the MBA

Planning to stack reductions that cannot be combined - the merit scholarships exclude everything except the Full Payment and Academic Year payment reductions, and the Early Bird cannot be combined with the MU Alumni Grant or the MCC Scholarship

Letting the English certificate lapse past two years, or sitting the test but booking it rather than taking it - MU only accepts a booked exam date for review, and visa-track applicants then get no conditional acceptance
Missing the Super Early Bird window and silently losing EUR 1,000 of tuition discount
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Housing and all living costs in Vienna, which MU states are not included in tuition; the one-semester Foundation Program Business or Tech (EUR 9,000) that borderline applicants are routed into; any prerequisite courses assigned at admission, which carry an additional fee if failed or added to the curriculum; and travel, visa and residence-permit costs
document_audit: MU accepts only PDFs - a single JPEG scan or Word file in the bundle is a self-inflicted delay
The Master's motivation letter must fit on exactly 1 A4 page, so a two-page narrative is out of spec
You can apply before you hold your final high school certificate or Bachelor's diploma, but you must then submit your most up-to-date transcript and will only get provisional acceptance
MBA applicants need proof of three years in a responsible position - a generic CV line is not enough
Recommendation letters should be signed by the referee; for the 20th Anniversary call MU may ask for further financial-need documentation at its discretion, so keep payslips or equivalent ready
alerts: Deadlines are a discount ladder, not one closing date: for the Fall entry of the 2027/28 year the tiers are 15 January (Super Early Bird), 15 March (Early Bird) and 1 April (final, non-EU visa track); EU/EEA and visa-free-country applicants get until 15 August. Spring-tier dates run 15 June, 15 August and 1 September

The official site contradicts itself on the Early Bird figure: the Reductions & Grants page says EUR 2,000 (EUR 1,000 per semester) while the admissions page describes Super Early Bird as EUR 2,000 per academic year and Early Bird as EUR 1,000 per academic year - confirm the exact value and the combination rules in writing with recruitment@modul.ac.at before you rely on it
The 20th Anniversary Scholarship closes its eligibility to new applicants for the 2027/28 academic year only, and interviews run just once a month, so a late file can sit for weeks
Non-EU applicants who need a visa cannot receive a conditional acceptance letter until proof of English proficiency is supplied
Tuition fees are indexed twice a year, in January and June, so the discount you are quoted is applied to a fee schedule that can move
Applying after your intake's final deadline does not close the door but will almost certainly push you to the following semester
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Open an account on the MUVi portal, upload the PDF document bundle plus the video and budget if you are also chasing the 20th Anniversary Scholarship, then wait for the admissions team to invite you to a Microsoft Teams interview - the scholarship decision lands with your admission decision, normally within about 10 days of the interview (about 2 weeks for the 20th Anniversary call)
